rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; i1040gi p.38 line13 prints positive filing-status ceilings. The matching year parameter is always positive in every declared status; subtract_floor0(parameter,0) leaves that amount unchanged and adds no missing filer input. The extra floor does not change the printed quantity.

Ruling: representation; i1040gi p.38 QDCG worksheet line3 uses Form1040 line7a when ScheduleD is not filed; in the supported distribution-only route that amount is sd.distributions, while all direct sales/loss routes require ScheduleD. On the filed route, max(min(SD15,SD16),0) equals min(max(SD15,0),max(SD16,0)), the printed loss-to-zero rule. This compares the prepared, supported-return quantities; it does not claim arbitrary inconsistent supplied cross-form subtotals or all partial-input paths are equivalent.

Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. The No branch reads “Enter the amount from Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 7a” (i1040gi p. 38). When Schedule D is not required, line 7a carries the total capital gain distributions from Form 1099-DIV box 2a (i1040gi p. 33, line 7a, Exception 1), which is the value the project references directly (`sd.distributions`); the second transcription references line 7a literally. No change to the data.
